<h1 class="h1">Operating Systems</h1>
<p class="role">CS 301 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester I, 2019–20</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">CS 301 covers the three pieces of a modern operating system: virtualisation of the CPU and of memory, concurrency, and persistence. Lectures follow <i>Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces</i>, weekly labs put the ideas into practice, and students wrote an OS zine and carried out a group project.</p>
<dl class="facts">
  <dt>Instructor</dt><dd><a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Prof. Nipun Batra</a></dd>
  <dt>Email</dt><dd><a href="mailto:nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in">nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in</a></dd>
  <dt>Lectures</dt><dd>Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 11:00 am–12:00 noon, AB7/102</dd>
  <dt>Labs</dt><dd>Monday, 10:00 am–12:00 noon, AB7/109</dd>
  <dt>Teaching assistants</dt><dd><a href="#people">3 TAs</a></dd>
  <dt>Textbook</dt><dd><a href="http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/OSTEP/">Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces</a></dd>
</dl>

<div class="two rule-top">
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="midsem"><summary>Is there a mid-semester exam?</summary><p>No. The end-semester exam carries 10%; most of the grade comes from four quizzes, two lab exams, the project and the homework. See <a href="assessment.html#grading">Grading</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="project"><summary>Is there a project?</summary><p>Yes: a project in groups of four, worth 20%. Teams submit a timeline, give phase I updates and present a final demo. See the <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1eVVmBrCTXHa6XhfewG2S9_if11Ija0s_cNMBp5NMbww/edit?usp=sharing">project ideas</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="zine"><summary>What is the OS zine?</summary><p>A zine on an operating-systems topic, in the style of <a href="https://jvns.ca/zines/">Julia Evans's zines</a>. It is worth 2% and was due on 20 November.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="regrade"><summary>Can I ask for my score to be revised?</summary><p>Only if a question was left unchecked or the marks were totalled incorrectly.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="setup"><summary>What do I need for the labs and homework?</summary><p>A Linux environment. An <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jZVQRuomuYsuK5dkTyuVMxV4oNLFX8Hs/view">Ubuntu VirtualBox image</a> is provided, and the <a href="https://github.com/nipunbatra/nipunbatra.github.io/tree/master/teaching/os-fall-19/code">code used in classes</a> is on GitHub.</p></details>
</section>
